additional_signal_catalog.name: Steering wheel angle
additional_signal_catalog.description: Recorded steering-wheel angle before dividing by the 12:1 steering ratio. It depends on the ratio; Steering (road wheel) is the comparable value.

additional_signal_catalog.name: LF pressure
additional_signal_catalog.description: Recorded live tire pressure; it does not establish tire wear.

additional_signal_catalog.name: LF carcass temperature
additional_signal_catalog.description: Average of the recorded inner, middle, and outer carcass temperatures.

additional_signal_catalog.name: RF wheel slip
additional_signal_catalog.description: Wheel speed relative to recorded vehicle speed; positive is spin and negative is lock.

additional_signal_catalog.name: Center-front ride height

result.downsampling: lap-distance bins retain representative values plus speed range, minimum throttle, peak brake, and peak absolute steering

steering.label: Steering (road wheel)
steering.definition: Recorded SteeringWheelAngle divided by the recording's 12:1 steering ratio: the steer applied at the front wheels, comparable across steering ratios. The setup's steering offset (+6 deg) is not applied.

tire_stress.definition: bounded blend of brake fraction at speed, steering magnitude at speed, and lateral acceleration; it is not per-lap tread wear
